audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Nazirite vow and priestly blessing text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for voluntary Nazirite vow by man or woman, grape-product abstention, uncut hair, corpse-contact restriction, accidental defilement, completion offerings, and Aaronic blessing.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When man or woman makes a special vow, vow of Nazirite, to separate/consecrate oneself to YHWH,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:

verses.restored: from wine and strong drink he shall separate; vinegar of wine and vinegar of strong drink he shall not drink, and any juice of grapes he shall not drink, and fresh grapes or dried he shall not eat.

familiar.text: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

verses.restored: All days of his separation/consecration, from anything made from grapevine, from seeds even to skin, he shall not eat.

familiar.text: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

verses.restored: All days of vow of his separation/consecration, razor shall not pass over his head; until days are fulfilled for which he separated himself to YHWH, holy he shall be, letting locks of hair of his head grow.

familiar.text: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

verses.restored: All days he separates himself to YHWH, to dead soul/life he shall not come.

familiar.text: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

verses.restored: For father or mother, brother or sister, he shall not make himself unclean by them when they die, for consecration of his Divine is upon his head.

familiar.text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

verses.restored: All days of his separation/consecration he is holy to YHWH.

familiar.text: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.

verses.restored: If one dies suddenly beside him and he makes head of his consecration unclean, he shall shave his head on day of his cleansing; on seventh day he shall shave it.

familiar.text: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

verses.restored: On eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon to priest, to entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.restored: Priest shall make one as sin/purification offering and one as burnt offering, and make atonement/covering for him because he sinned/misaligned by dead soul/life; he shall sanctify his head that day.

familiar.text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

verses.restored: He shall separate to YHWH days of his consecration and bring male lamb, son of a year, as guilt/reparation offering; former days shall fall away because his consecration became unclean.

familiar.text: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction of Nazirite: on day days of his consecration are fulfilled, he shall be brought to entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.restored: He shall bring near his offering to YHWH: one complete male lamb, son of a year, as burnt offering; one complete female lamb, daughter of a year, as sin/purification offering; and one complete ram as peace/well-being offering,

familiar.text: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

verses.restored: and basket of unleavened breads of fine flour, cakes mixed with oil and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, with their grain offering and drink offerings.

familiar.text: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.restored: Priest shall bring them near before YHWH and make his sin/purification offering and burnt offering.

familiar.text: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

verses.restored: The ram he shall make as sacrifice of peace/well-being to YHWH with basket of unleavened bread; priest shall make its grain offering and drink offering.

familiar.text: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.restored: Nazirite shall shave head of his consecration at entrance of tent of meeting, take hair of head of his consecration, and put it on fire under sacrifice of peace/well-being.

familiar.text: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

verses.restored: Priest shall take boiled shoulder from ram, one unleavened cake from basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them on palms of Nazirite after he has shaved his consecration.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

verses.restored: Priest shall wave them as wave offering before YHWH; holy it is for priest, with breast of wave offering and thigh of contribution; afterward Nazirite may drink wine.

familiar.text: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction of Nazirite who vows his offering to YHWH according to his separation/consecration, besides what his hand reaches; according to vow he vows, so he shall do, according to Torah/instruction of his consecration.

familiar.text: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying: Thus you shall bless children of Israel, saying to them:

familiar.text: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

verses.restored: May YHWH bless you and keep you.

familiar.text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

verses.restored: May YHWH make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you.

familiar.text: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

verses.restored: May YHWH lift up his face toward you and give you peace/shalom.

familiar.text: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

verses.restored: They shall put my name upon children of Israel, and I myself will bless them.

familiar.text: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

translation_notes: The Nazirite vow is available to man or woman, an important shared-access feature.
Nazir terminology includes separation/consecration; avoid equating holiness with disgust toward ordinary food, drink, hair, or family grief.
Accidental corpse defilement resets the vow but should not be framed as moral blame for an unexpected death.
Completion includes burnt, purification, peace/well-being, grain, and drink offerings, followed by renewed permission to drink wine.
The Aaronic blessing culminates in shalom: wholeness, peace, well-being, and restored relational harmony.
The priests place YHWH's name on Israel, but the text says YHWH is the one who blesses.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 6 to pressure people into ascetic vows, shame alcohol abstainers or drinkers, condemn hair choices, suppress grief, or blame someone for accidental ritual interruption. The vow is voluntary and time-bounded; the chapter culminates in grace and shalom.
